# External data backbone

**Provider:** National Laboratory of the Rockies / AFDC  
**Dataset:** Alternative Fuel Stations API  
**Source:** https://developer.nlr.gov/docs/transportation/alt-fuel-stations-v1/  
**DOI/reference:** AFDC public station database  
**License/terms:** US government/public API; review provider terms

Advertised source scale: live EV charging-station locations, networks, ports and infrastructure attributes.

Run `./data/external/fetch_public_data.ps1` on an internet-connected Windows machine to refresh the public source. Offline acceptance uses repository reference evidence and never relabels that fixture as external observation.
